A rocky '''planet''' was the location of the [[Carbonite Sith Tomb]], which housed a [[Carbonite Sith Army]] along with a [[Carbonite Sith Master]]. It was found by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Silri]] after she studied a [[Carbonite Sith Army holocron|holocron]] acquired by [[Tyber Zann]].
